correctness.rationale: A direct Fréchet–Hoeffding lower-bound integral proves the local all-copula minimum. Exact rational moments give 1/2880, 1/360, 1/180. Uniform C^2 interpolation and cellwise independence yield the sharp 1/11520, 1/1440, 1/720 limits; quadratic f gives equality for all meshes. The package verifier independently checks exact polynomial identities, not the universal proof.
